scope.summary: Build the professional native Tailor interlink pane for verified PoseKit evidence, character-sheet mapping, lift/camera/contact proposals, and the MT-749 TailorMixGraph projection with source/layer weights, conflicts, preview, selected apply, detach, repair, provenance, and recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Tailor opens PaneType::AtelierEditor through the shared typed pane-navigation route and selects AtelierPanelTab::Posekit or AtelierPanelTab::CastkitCodex through the typed panel API; atelier-tab-posekit, atelier-content-posekit, atelier-tab-ckc, atelier-content-ckc, atelier-ckc-character-ref, atelier-ckc-sheet-version-ref, and atelier-ckc-sheet-artifact-list are inspection targets only, never the navigation API or Tailor ownership.

Provides stable native ids tailor-interlink-pane, tailor-interlink-binding-source, tailor-interlink-receipt-validity, tailor-interlink-lift-state, tailor-interlink-joint-confidence, tailor-interlink-camera-candidates, tailor-interlink-reprojection-error, tailor-interlink-contact-state, tailor-interlink-proposal-diff, tailor-interlink-stale-conflict, tailor-interlink-job-status, tailor-interlink-cancel, and tailor-interlink-retry.

Manual correction supports accept/reject/remap joint, camera-candidate selection, 3D handle correction, immutable amended proposal, compare, and revert before explicit selected apply through typed backend commands.

The interlink pane is the owning native projection for MT-749 and renders the authoritative TailorMixGraphV1 graph, source nodes, target slots, normalized and over-range region/layer weights, ordering, correspondence, conflicts, provenance, derived previews, selected apply, detach, rebase, and repair; it never redefines mix authority in UI-local state.

Blank, loading, partial, tampered, offline, merge-incompatible, stale/conflicted, cancelled, failed, and retry states remain distinguishable; Jobs, Problems, and History expose attribution, progress, diagnostics, recovery, and receipts without stealing focus.

Argus/AccessKit proves docked, floating, narrow, 4K, and DPI layouts; keyboard/focus order, non-color state, readable text, no overlap/clipping, cancellation, retry, and no-focus-steal behavior are required.

Stable native control/element ids include tailor-interlink-open-posekit, tailor-interlink-open-ckc, tailor-interlink-joint-{joint_id}-accept, tailor-interlink-joint-{joint_id}-reject, tailor-interlink-joint-{joint_id}-remap, tailor-interlink-camera-{candidate_id}-select, tailor-interlink-contact-{contact_id}, tailor-interlink-correct-3d, tailor-interlink-compare-{proposal_revision}, tailor-interlink-revert-{proposal_revision}, and tailor-interlink-selected-apply; template substitutions identify controls/records only and are never action ids.

Those controls bind exact canonical actions `tailor.interlink.open-posekit`, `tailor.interlink.open-character-sheet`, `tailor.interlink.accept-joint`, `tailor.interlink.reject-joint`, `tailor.interlink.remap-joint`, `tailor.interlink.select-camera`, `tailor.interlink.edit-contact`, `tailor.interlink.correct-3d`, `tailor.interlink.compare-proposal`, `tailor.interlink.revert-proposal`, and the applicable `tailor.mix.*` seed actions; joint_id, candidate_id, contact_id, proposal_revision, node_id, and conflict_id are typed inputs, never action-id segments.

Every repeated inspectable record has a stable escaped typed-id row identity: tailor-interlink-joint-{joint_id}-row, tailor-interlink-camera-{candidate_id}-row, tailor-interlink-contact-{contact_id}-row, and tailor-interlink-proposal-{proposal_revision}-row; selection/control ids and bound action inputs resolve to the same typed record without relying on row position.

The exact TailorSurfaceDescriptor row MT-718 enumerates every route, pane, control author_id, dynamic entity-key rule, canonical ACT-010 action binding, state, help anchor, permission, undo policy, receipt, and command binding required by 13.30 [TAI-ACT-007, TAI-ACT-010], 13.33 [TAI-INT-002..003, TAI-INT-006], and 13.34 [TAI-UX-001..005]; wildcard-only evidence is rejected.

Applicable blank, loading, populated, stale/conflict, cancelled, failed, retry, permission, keyboard/focus, narrow/4K/DPI, overlap/clipping, and no-focus-steal states are covered by the registry-derived Argus matrix.

The exact TailorSurfaceDescriptor row MT-718 enumerates every route, pane, control author_id, dynamic entity-key rule, action, state, help anchor, permission, undo policy, receipt, and command binding; wildcard-only evidence is rejected.
scope.risk_if_missed: A shallow or ambiguous pane would cause operators and models to confuse 2D evidence with applied 3D authority or miss stale/tampered source state.

surfaces: Tailor mix-graph editor within the interlink pane
Tailor Jobs, Problems, and History projections

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > PoseKit and character-sheet interlinking

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.

Use authenticated SurrealDB record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; administrative/root credentials and UI filtering are never the security boundary. PostgreSQL and SQLite access paths are forbidden.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
